📊 BEI turunkan gocap ke Rp1

- Minimum saham turun dari Rp50 ke Rp1 mulai 28/9/2026
- 6 saham anjlok ke level baru termasuk GoTo (GOTO.JK)

source_title: GoTo, MNC Group Shares Fall Below Rp50 as IDX Lowers Minimum Share Price to Rp1

content:
💼 Akuisisi 30% saham Bayan Resources (BYAN)

- PT Jhonlin Baratama caplok 10 miliar saham (~30%) dari Low Tuck Kwong
- Low Tuck tetap controlling shareholder setelah transaksi
- RKAB Tambang Tiwa Abadi, Tanur Jaya & Fajar Sakti sudah approved 23/9

Source: https://www.cnnindonesia.com/ekonomi/20260928130459-92-1409012/low-tuck-kwong-tetap-pengendali-bayan-meski-haji-isam-caplok-30-saham
source_title: Low Tuck Kwong to Remain Controlling Shareholder of PT Bayan Resources Tbk (BYAN) as PT Jhonlin Baratama Acquires 30% Stake

content:
🏥 Kalbe Farma (KLBF): margin tertekan, proyeksi pulih 2027

- H1-2026 revenue +14.05% jadi Rp19.48T
- Laba neto turun 2.74% jadi Rp1.97T; gross margin drop ke 37.56%
- BRI Danareksa target Rp1,000 | Phintraco Rp1,500 | Sinarmas Rp900

Source: https://investasi.kontan.co.id/news/buyback-klbf-jadi-katalis-prospek-laba-diproyeksi-membaik
source_title: PT Kalbe Farma Tbk (KLBF) Buyback Seen as Catalyst as Earnings Projected to Recover from 2027
